# 2) Capstone Project - Fuel type Mapping

## Preliminary Fuel Type Map

```{r leaflet, include = FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(terra)

# 1. Load the raster from your local path
# Note: For GitHub, remember to move this file to your project folder 
# and use a relative path like rast("Preliminary_FTM.tif")
Pre_FTM_raw <- rast("C:/Users/kelvin55.stu/OneDrive - UBC/Documents/GitHub/E-Portfolio/E_Portfolio/Preliminary_FTM.tif")

# 2. Manually project from EPSG:32610 to EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator)
# We use method = "near" (nearest neighbor) to ensure your fuel type 
# integers don't get blurred into decimals.
Pre_FTM <- project(Pre_FTM_raw, "EPSG:3857", method = "near")

# 3. Define the labels and colors exactly as you requested
fuel_labels <- c("Broadleaf", "Conifer", "Shrub", "Grass", "Bare Soil", "Urban", "Water")
fuel_colors <- c("#00FF00", "#008000", "#FF0000", "#E69F00", "#808080", "#FFFFFF", "#0000FF")

# 4. Create the Palette mapping values 1-7 to your colors
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = fuel_colors,
  domain = 1:7,
  na.color = "transparent"
)

# 5. Build the Leaflet Map
Lea_01 <- leaflet(width = 600, height = 600) %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%
  addRasterImage(
    Pre_FTM, 
    colors = pal, 
    opacity = 0.8, 
    # Increased maxBytes to 30MB to prevent downsampling gaps
    maxBytes = 30 * 1024 * 1024, 
    project = FALSE  # Telling Leaflet it's already in the right CRS
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal, 
    values = 1:7, 
    opacity = 0.8, 
    title = "Fuel Type",
    # Swaps the 1-7 numbers for your class names in the legend
    labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) fuel_labels[x])
  ) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft")

```

```{r map, echo=FALSE}
Lea_01
```
